evidence_population: current prediction owner < 0 AND original future label valid

auc.zero: excluded only from binary AUC; count retained
auc.weight: 1 / number of ALL original valid points in the same anchor-object-horizon
auc.formula: weighted positive-negative ranking probability; tied scores count 0.5
auc.undefined: null if either weighted class has no support
auc.per_scene: same weights and classes, every one of 256 scenes; undefined is null
auc.scene_summary: equal-scene median and 25/75 percentiles over defined scene AUCs; not a confidence interval

speed_control.within_bin_auc_weight: original object weight, not renormalized within bin

continuous.conditional_mean: sum(point_weight * benefit) / sum(point_weight) in named subset
continuous.full_contribution: sum(point_weight * benefit) / ALL original object count in named horizon/group
continuous.positive_gain: same full denominator, include only benefit > 0
continuous.negative_cost: same full denominator, sum -benefit for benefit < 0
continuous.empty_subset: conditional mean null; full contribution zero when full denominator exists

physical.mean: point Euclidean error within original object, then equal original-object mean
physical.parts: covered/uncovered point error sums / original object point count, then original-object mean
physical.fixed_blend: CRN_CV on owner>=0; D on owner<0; no GT routing
physical.missing_future: original label valid only; do not invent zero-error observations

limitations: D saw every train512 scene; no held-out D generalization claim
four horizons are outputs of one head, not independent observations
smoothness is not certainty; magnitude and relative residual are coupled
large AUC for tiny gains does not establish a useful routing rule
rigid-box sparse material-point proxy omits unlabeled and ambiguous source regions
no occupancy result, no O flow and no claim of exceeding O
